UniversalFormatContract.Rule: Admit only canonical on-disk big-endian FAT_MAGIC cafebabe (20-byte fat_arch rows) and FAT_MAGIC_64 cafebabf (32-byte fat_arch_64 rows). CIGAM is a swapped host view, not a new little-endian on-disk format requirement. Bare magic/Java data is insufficient.

Use fstat on the same already-open descriptor and bounded exact metadata reads. Count must be nonzero; the complete8+count*rowBytes table must fit actual file length and a4096-byte metadata bound (max203 FAT32/127 FAT64). Short header/table/member reads are invalid=false; actual I/O failures keep existing propagation and fd finally-close.

Decode uint64 offsets/sizes with BigInt; do all range/end/alignment arithmetic without overflow/rounding. Require offset>=tableEnd, size>=complete member header, positive size, end<=file length and safe integer conversion before a Number read position. Reject unrepresentable values rather than round. Check FAT32 alignment exponent<=31, FAT64<=63, and offset modulo2**align=0. FAT64 reserved field must be0.

All declared slice ranges must be pairwise disjoint and outside the table. Reject duplicate architecture identities (cputype plus low24 cpusubtype) conservatively; no host-CPU allowlist or host-selected-only slice validation. Validate every slice before returning true.

Every member must be a complete thin Mach-O32(28-byte) or64(32-byte) header, in its own thin endian, filetype MH_EXECUTE2; matching cputype and cpusubtype low24 bits (high8 are capability flags). Require sizeofcmds<=sliceSize-headerSize as a bounded structural header check. Reject nested FAT, static/object/archive, ELF/PE members, MH_OBJECT/MH_DYLIB, truncated members and CPU/subtype mismatches. No full load-command/signature/loader/host-architecture policy is introduced.
